{{Quote|You did it! Valarian's so pleased she's told me to let you into the inner sanctum. That means you'll be dealing with Ind from now on.|[[Kavas Urdano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kavas Urdano|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Ind''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] criminal who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She worked for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ind says she has some work for you, or if you want I have something else for you to do.|[[Kavas Urdano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ind worked for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]], in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The Gran was one of the two main lieutenants of Lady Valarian, the other being the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] woman [[Kavas Urdano]]. Ind and Urdano had a very conflicting relationship as both rivaled to get Valarian's attention.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref>

[[File:LuckyDespot.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''[[Lucky Despot]]'']]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the conflict between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and Lady Valarian, her biggest competitor on Tatooine, turned to open war. At that time, Kavas Urdano recruited skilled [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to help her with several missions. Those adventurers later went to work for Ind and the Gran provided them with [[Q2 hold-out blaster|Republic blasters]]. During one of their first missions, the spacers rescued a Valarian's compound guard who was carrying a [[Rill (species)|rill]] casserole for Lady Valarian from a Jabba's henchman. Later, Ind was informed that a scientist specialized in beam weapons named [[Kaum]] had been recruited by Jabba. As the scientist was just arriving on Tatooine and did not know any of Jabba's men, Ind tasked a spacer with picking him up before Jabba's thugs. The spacer thus encountered [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Kaum upon his arrival in Mos Eisley and escorted him back to Ind at the ''Lucky Despot''. Unaware that he had been deceived, the scientist began to work for the Valarian syndicate rather than for Jabba's organization. A short time later, Ind discovered that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Roden Venthrall]] had been hired to assassinate Lady Valarian. The Gran promptly dispatched a spacer to find and kill the assassin before he could murder Valarian. Later, Ind found out that Jabba was attempting to poison the water supplies of the ''Lucky Despot''. Fortunately, the spacers killed the three Jabba's enforcers and recovered the toxic rations. Thereafter, Lady Valarian tasked Ind with stealing an expensive [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Egg/Legends|egg]] that had been ordered by Jabba himself to be cooked by his [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]]. After the spacers succeeded in stealing the egg from Jabba's enforcers, Lady Valarian was so pleased that she requested Ind to have the spacers working personally for her.<ref name="SWG:I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ind was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:I" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ind was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:I" />

With "[[W:c:swg:Publish 20 Notes for 19 July 2005|Publish 20]]" released on [[July 19]], [[2005]], it was announced that the "Valarian Quest Series" would be phased out during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 22 Notes for 16 August 2005|Publish 22]]" to make way for a revamped questline during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> The story of this new [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark] was centered on the rivalry between Ind and Kavas Urdano.<ref name="Sony" /> While the old Valarian Quest Series was fully deactivated by Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the newly proposed questline was never fully implemented to replace it. Ind remained present in the game but was not involved in any quest anymore.<ref name="SWG:P25">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Publish 25}}</ref>
